blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions.
While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions.
Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress.
In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models.
We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions.
Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one.
We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations.
Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
现代Visual-Language导航(VLN)模型大多依靠预先训练的大型Visual-Language模型(VLM)来预测导航动作.

因此,VLN模型是将其预测建立在相关的语义提示中还是能够跟踪任务进展,这一点仍然不清楚。
在这项工作中,我们研究VLN模型的可解释性和可引导性.
我们使用基于干预的度量法,测量视觉观测,指示,和视觉记忆如何因果地影响导航决策.
我们的结果表明,这些导航政策对所有输入方式都很敏感,并不依赖于一种输入方式。
我们进一步表明,这些物剂编码导航进度,并保留其VLM主干线的语义结构,通过内部激活使概念层面的指导成为可能。
最后,我们提取抽象行为的激活矢量,将其零射转至外分配现实世界的情景,在不增加微调的情况下提高性能.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-Language-Navigation (VLN) [ 1 , 2 ] models have demonstrated increased embodied intelligence on navigation benchmarks [ 3 , 4 ] .
This progress has largely been driven by pretrained large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that jointly process natural-language instruction and visual observations to predict navigation actions end-to-end.
Modern VLN architectures further introduce reasoning [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] , linguistic [ 8 ] and spatial memories [ 9 ] to encourage semantic grounding, task decomposition, and progress tracking.
blocks.zh:
远景-语言-导航(VLN)[1,2]模型显示,关于导航基准的内在情报有所增加[3,4]。
这一进展在很大程度上是由经过预先训练的大型视野-语言模型(VLM)推动的,这些模型联合处理自然语言教学和视觉观测,以预测导航行动的端到端.
现代VLN架构进一步引入推理[5,6,7],语言[8]和空间记忆[9],以鼓励语义定位,任务分解,以及进度跟踪.

blocks.en:
While these benchmarks primarily evaluate models through closed-loop success rate, improvements in navigation performance alone do not prove that these components function as intended.
A model may rely on relevant landmarks, exploit correlations learned during training, or compensate for missing information through another modality, and still produce the same trajectory.
Understanding what the model attends to and relies on internally is necessary to better characterize the mechanisms underlying embodied reasoning.
blocks.zh:
虽然这些基准主要通过闭路运行成功率来评价模型,但单靠导航性能的改进并不能证明这些组件按预期发挥功能.
一个模型可能依赖相关的地标,利用在培训过程中学到的关联性,或通过另一种方式弥补缺失的信息,并且仍然产生相同的轨迹.
了解模型在内部关注和依赖的内容,对于更好地说明体现的推理所依据的机制是必要的。

blocks.en:
Yet, these mechanisms remain poorly understood: it is unclear how VLN models route information between modalities, how navigation concepts are stored, and whether these representations causally influence action predictions.
Analyzing these questions can reveal how VLN models internally process information during navigation, complementing usual benchmark evaluation.
Moreover, navigation failures may not necessarily reflect the absence of task-relevant concepts; instead, a model may encode the required information but fail to use it effectively during action selection.
In such cases, steering internal representations could provide an alternative to collecting additional data to retrain the model.
blocks.zh:
然而,对这些机制的理解仍然不足:VLN模型在模式之间的路由信息,导航概念的存储方式,以及这些表示是否因果影响动作预测,尚不清楚.
分析这些问题可以揭示VLN在导航过程中如何在内部处理信息,补充通常的基准评价.
此外,导航故障不一定反映缺乏与任务有关的概念;相反,一个模型可能编码所需信息,但在选择行动时未能有效地使用。
在这种情况下,指导内部陈述可为收集补充数据重新培训模型提供一个替代办法。

blocks.en:
To understand the internal mechanisms of VLN policies, we conduct a study that combines input attribution and causal interventions to quantify how visual observations, instructions, and memory influence actions.
We steer the model using semantic concepts and hidden state activations within the model.
Our main contributions are: • The first causal interpretability study of VLM-based VLNs on the sensitivity and robustness to changes in the model input, specifically semantic cues. • A steering study that investigates navigation-relevant representations that persist after VLM finetuning and how these representations can be used to influence model behavior. • An activation steering-based real-world deployment that induces navigation recovery without updating model parameters in out-of-domain settings.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Vision-and-Language Navigation
blocks.zh: II-A 远景和语言导航

blocks.en:
Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to navigate through an environment by following a natural-language instruction [ 3 , 12 ] .
Recent approaches build VLN agents around Vision-Language Models (VLMs).
NaVid [ 13 ] introduces a video-based VLM that predicts navigation actions.
NaVILA [ 14 ] extends VLA-based navigation to legged robots.
CorrectNav [ 11 ] learns from erroneous trajectories, while AwareVLN [ 6 ] introduces reasoning behavior.
DualVLN [ 15 ] uses a VLM along with a diffusion-based action expert, whereas Efficient-VLN [ 1 ] focuses on reducing the computational cost of processing long navigation histories.
Together, these developments demonstrate the increasing capability of VLM-based navigation agents.
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言导航(VLN)要求一个体现的代理通过遵循自然语言指令[3,12]在环境中导航.
最近的办法围绕Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)建立了VLN代理.
NaVid [13]引入了基于视频的VLM,预测导航动作.
NaVILA [14] 将基于VLA的导航扩展至腿部机器人.
正确Nav [11] 从错误的轨迹中吸取教训,而alderVLN [6]引入推理行为.
DualVLN [15] 使用VLM和基于扩散的动作专家,而高效VLN [1]则侧重于降低处理长导航历史的计算成本.
这些事态发展共同表明,以甚高频为基础的导航剂的能力正在增强。

blocks.en: II-B Interpretability and Grounding Analysis
blocks.zh: 二-B 可解释性和地基分析

blocks.en:
Several interpretability techniques have been proposed for understanding deep neural networks.
Previous works [ 16 , 17 ] compute input relevance by using gradient-based methods.
Perturbation-based methods [ 18 ] estimate feature importance by observing changes under randomized masking.
More recent methods [ 19 , 20 ] extend interpretability to autoregressive models.
However, these methods were primarily developed and evaluated on prediction tasks such as image classification, rather than embodied tasks.
blocks.zh:
已提出若干解释性技术,以了解深神经网络。
前作[16,17]通过使用梯度法计算输入相关性.
基于扰动的方法[18]通过在随机化的遮罩下观测变化而呈现出其重要性。
较近的方法[19,20]将可解释性扩展至自递性模型.
然而,这些方法主要是针对图像分类等预测任务,而不是包含的任务来制定和评估的.

blocks.en:
Few works analyze the internal grounding of VLN agents.
Hu et al. [ 21 ] study how language grounds to visual appearance and route structure.
Zhu et al. [ 22 ] identify imbalances between visual and textual attention, reinforcing the open question about whether attention maps alone provide reliable evidence of explanation [ 23 ] .
Chen et al. [ 24 ] evaluate explanation methods for transformer-based VLN.
Nevertheless, none of these methods evaluate VLM-based VLNs.
Recent work [ 10 ] has studied interpretability in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models.
Their experiments focus on robotic manipulation tasks rather than VLN, but provide an interventional approach for studying whether embodied policies rely on task-relevant visual evidence.

很少有作品分析VLN特工的内部定位.

然而,这些方法中没有任何一种评估以自愿劳动和重新安置为基础的自愿劳动和重新安置。
最近的工作[10]研究了远景-语言-行动模型中的可解释性。
他们的实验侧重于机器人操纵任务而不是VLN,但为研究体现的政策是否依赖于与任务相关的视觉证据提供了一个干预方法.

blocks.en: II-C Steering
blocks.zh: 二-C 指导

blocks.en:
Steering is a popular method to influence model behavior.
For LLMs, previous work [ 25 , 26 ] extracted latent steering directions and applied inference-time interventions, while others [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] found contrastive vectors for activation-based steering.
Subsequent work identified low-dimensional directions [ 30 ] while also exposing limitations in the generalization and reliability of steering vectors [ 31 ] .
Recent work [ 32 ] explores steering for VLAs by using value vectors from the VLM backbone to control action prediction.
Other work [ 33 ] uses activation steering to propose a linear observer and controller for latent states.
Hong et al. [ 34 ] model transformer dynamics and use LQR to steer World Action Models.
Despite steady progress in steering methods for VLAs, steering for VLNs remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
引导是影响模型行为的一种流行方法.
对于LLMS来说,先前的工作[25、26]提取了潜在的指导方向和应用推论时间干预,而其他[27、28、29]则发现了以激活为基础的指导的对比矢量。
随后的工作确定了低维方向[30],同时也暴露了方向矢量的概括性和可靠性方面的局限性[31].
最近的工作[32]通过使用来自VLM主干线的值矢量来控制动作预测来探索对VLA的引导.
其他工作 [33] 使用激活引导为潜在状态提出线性观察和控制器.
洪等编. [34] 模型变压器动力学,并使用LQR来引导世界行动模型.
尽管在志愿军指导方法方面稳步取得进展,但是对志愿军的指导仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: V-A VLN Baselines

blocks.en:
For this study, we compare CorrectNav [ 11 ] , DualVLN [ 15 ] , AwareVLN [ 6 ] , and NaVILA [ 14 ] , which are VLM-based.
Although all four methods condition on a language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, they differ in their backbones, visual memory sampling, reasoning mechanisms, action spaces, camera configurations, and prompt formats.
CorrectNav, DualVLN, and AwareVLN report a similar success rate of ∼ \sim 65% in the VLN-CE R2R benchmark [ 3 , 36 ] , whereas NaVILA reports ∼ \sim 54%.
We run all of our experiments on a subset of validation unseen in R2R VLN-CE.
We ran each baseline in its nominal camera, forward, and turning step configurations, which thus differ between methods.

对于本研究,我们比较了正确Nav [11], DualVLN [15], 了解VLN [6],和NaVILA [14],它们以VLM为基础.
虽然所有四种方法都以语言教学和以自我为中心的RGB观测为条件,但它们的骨干,视觉内存取样,推理机制,动作空间,相机配置,以及即时格式不同.

We evaluate ISS and IG explanations on 200 200 open-loop decision points sampled from the dataset.

We emphasize that our goal is not to perform semantic segmentation,
rather, the annotations provide a human-defined reference for visual evidence important at a particular decision point.
Therefore, we focus on precision rather than recall, F1, or mean IoU, where high precision identifies whether the k k % peaks of the explanation map are concentrated on the annotated decision-relevant regions.
blocks.zh:
我们强调我们的目标不是进行语义分裂,
相反,说明为在特定决定点重要的视觉证据提供了人定义的参考。
因此,我们侧重于精确而不是回顾F1,或者指IoU,其中高精确度确定解释图的k k%峰值是否集中在附加说明的决定相关区域.

blocks.en:
The precision metrics are shown in Table I .
Across our experiments, ISS explanations obtain stronger annotation alignment than IG explanations.
This might be because gradients struggle to propagate from the output likelihood through the entire model back to the input pixels (i.e., vanishing gradients).
This long gradient path produces diffuse attribution maps, as shown in Fig. 2 .
In contrast, ISS measures behavioral sensitivity by perturbing the visual input and observing changes in the model’s navigation behavior.
blocks.zh:
精确度量表见表一。
在我们的实验中,国际空间站的解释比IG的解释更能说明问题。
这可能是因为梯度挣扎着从输出可能性通过整个模型传播回输入像素(即渐变).
如图2所示,这种长的梯度路径会产生分散的归属图。
相比之下,ISS通过干扰视觉输入和观察模型导航行为的变化来测量行为敏感性.

blocks.en:
We observe that the differences between models are most apparent at lower k k values.
For example, CorrectNav assigns higher attribution to the annotated regions at low k k , indicating stronger peak visual focus.
In contrast, NaVILA shows weaker alignment at low k k , suggesting that its most salient ISS regions are less concentrated on the annotated areas.
As k k increases, the metric includes broader portions of the heatmap, and the gap between models becomes less focused on peak localization and more reflective of wider attribution coverage.
In conclusion, the ISS and IG precisions of ∼ \sim 40-60% across all methods suggest that, while a decent share of the visual attention lies on relevant cues, current VLN pipelines are roughly equally sensitive to cues deemed irrelevant by a human. This sensitivity might be a residual of spurious correlations during training or indicative of limited training data diversity.
blocks.zh:
我们观测到,模型之间的差异在较低的kk值中最为明显.
例如,RightNav将更高的归属分配到低kk的注解区域,表明更高的峰值视觉焦点.
与此相反,NaVILA在低k k 的坐标比弱,表明其最突出的国际空间站区域不太集中在附加说明的区域。
随着kk的增长,该计量标准包括了热图中更广泛的部分,模型之间的差距也变得不太注重于峰值本地化,更能反映更广泛的归属范围。
最后,各种方法的ISS和IG精度 \sim 40-60% 都表明,虽然视觉注意力中相当一部分位于相关线索上,但目前的VLN管道对人类认为无关的线索大致同样敏感。 这种敏感性可能是培训期间虚假关联的残余,或表明培训数据多样性有限。

blocks.en:
Additionally, we perform a qualitative analysis over the TAM heatmaps.
As seen in Fig. 2 , TAM produces relatively interpretable localization for semantically grounded concepts with clear visual references.
However, its behavior is considerably less reliable for abstract VLN output tokens such as move forward .
Since such tokens do not correspond to a single, well-defined visual entity in the scene, the resulting activation maps tend to be diffuse and difficult to interpret.
This suggests that TAM is better suited to visualizing object- or concept-level semantics than explaining abstract navigation decisions.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们对TAM热图进行了定性分析。
如图2所示,TAM对有清晰视觉参考的有源概念产生相对可解释的地方化.
然而,对于抽象的VLN输出符号,比如前进,它的行为则相当不可靠.
由于这种符号与场景中一个单一的,定义明确的视觉实体并不对应,因此由此产生的激活图往往会扩散,难以解释.
这表明TAM比解释抽象导航决定更适合可视化对象-或概念级语义.

blocks.en: V-C Sensitivity to Visual Memory
blocks.zh: V-C 对视觉记忆的敏感性

blocks.en:
To evaluate how past observations influence navigation decisions, we compute ISS by blurring a percentage p p of the images in memory, from oldest to most recent.
We run perturbations for 12 episodes with three variations of the verbal command per trajectory in all scenes of the validation unseen split.
For a fair comparison between pipelines, we run each baseline over the ground-truth trajectory and compute the ISS score.
Note that the trajectory horizon of AwareVLN and NaVILA is 1 to 3 steps, whereas CorrectNav and DualVLN execute 3 to 4 steps.
Thus, one cannot directly compare ISS between the two horizon groups.
We instead report normalized ISS scores per method to provide insights about their sensitivity patterns.
blocks.zh:
为了评价过去的观测如何影响导航决策,我们计算国际空间站的方法是模糊记忆中的图像的百分点p,从最古老到最近。
我们运行了12集的扰动, 3个变体 每一个轨道的口头命令 在所有场景 在未见的分裂。
为了对输油管进行公平比较,我们按地面真实轨迹计算每个基线,计算国际空间站的得分。
请注意, " 了解VLN " 和 " NaVILA " 的轨迹是1至3步,而 " 正确Nav " 和 " DualVLN " 则执行3至4步。
因此,人们无法直接比较两个地平线组之间的国际空间站。
相反,我们报告国际空间站每套方法的正常分数,以提供对其敏感性模式的见解。

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 shows the mean ISS score per trajectory length and memory corruption percentage in accumulated bins.
A natural expectation is that ISS increases with trajectory progress, since early memory observations are often highly correlated, whereas later ones span a longer history and provide more distinct cues about the agent’s progress.
Note that monotonic vertical growth in the ISS is not required, since ISS may not change if historical images become redundant or localized if only particular landmarks matter for the current decision.
CorrectNav and DualVLN show increased sensitivity with both trajectory progress and corruption strength, indicating stronger dependency on information distributed across their visual history.
DualVLN exhibits sensitivity to visual-memory degradation earlier in the trajectory than CorrectNav.
This may stem from DualVLN’s hierarchical structure: historical observations are distilled into a latent bottleneck before passing through the diffusion policy, whereas CorrectNav outputs actions directly from the VLM, potentially allowing the instruction to compensate for corrupted historical cues.
CorrectNav also explicitly annotates temporal tags for the history frames in the prompt, potentially encouraging the use of distributed memory cues at later timesteps.
blocks.zh:
图3显示国际空间站每轨距的平均得分和累积箱的内存腐败百分比。
一个自然的期望是,国际空间站随着轨迹进展而增加,因为早期的内存观测往往高度相关,而后来的观测则跨越较长的历史,为代理人的进步提供了更鲜明的提示。
请注意,国际空间站不需要单调纵向增长,因为如果历史图像变得多余或局部化,那么国际空间站不会发生变化,如果对目前的决定来说只有特定的地标很重要的话。
RightNav和DualVLN显示出对轨迹进展和腐败强度的敏感性提高,表明更加依赖在其视觉历史中散发的信息。
DualVLN在轨迹中比RevectNav更早表现出视觉-记忆降解的敏感性.
这可能源于DualVLN的等级结构:在通过扩散政策之前,历史观察被提炼成潜在的瓶颈,而RightNav则直接通过VLM输出行动,有可能使指令能够补偿腐败的历史暗示。
RightNav还明确在即时对历史帧的时间标记进行注释,可能鼓励在后期使用分布式内存提示.

blocks.en:
AwareVLN and NaVILA show weaker accumulation effects, indicating a stronger reliance on a more recent subset of observations.
Although NaVILA and AwareVLN share the same memory sampling schema, they differ in their reasoning paradigm.
AwareVLN uses chain-of-thought reasoning that can reaffirm or correct perceived progress, adding redundant information to the prompt that can compensate for corrupted visual memory.
This might explain why AwareVLN’s overall sensitivity to memory corruption is lower than NaVILA’s, which has no other source of progress tracking than the visual memory.
NaVILA shows increased sensitivity during the earliest timesteps, reflecting a cold-start regime of the memory where initial observations may disproportionately matter for understanding orientation (i.e., away from a wall).
blocks.zh:
了解VLN和NaVILA显示积累效应较弱,表明更依赖较新的一组观测。
虽然NaVILA和AreatyVLN有着相同的内存采样计划,但它们在推理范式上有所不同.
知識VLN使用可重申或纠正所感知的进步的思维链推理,将冗余信息添加到可以弥补被腐蚀的视觉记忆的提示中.
这或许可以解释为什么了解VLN对记忆腐败的总体敏感度低于NaVILA,后者除了视觉记忆之外,没有其他的进展跟踪来源.

blocks.en: V-D Robustness to Visual Memory
blocks.zh: V-D 强健到视觉记忆

blocks.en:
It is important to point out that sensitivity analyses how strongly perturbing past visual observations changes the action predicted at a fixed state along the ground-truth trajectory.
It does not indicate whether the original or perturbed action is correct during closed-loop execution.
To evaluate robustness to closed-loop memory degradation, Table II reports the success rate versus the fraction of early visual memory that is blurred.
At low and moderate corruption levels, all pipelines remain relatively robust, with only limited degradation up to about 50 % 50\% memory corruption, after which their behaviors diverge.
Despite exhibiting substantial action sensitivity to memory blurring, CorrectNav has the most robust closed-loop performance when only the current image is available.
Similarly, while AwareVLN has lower open-loop sensitivity, it suffers larger closed-loop success-rate degradation than the other VLNs.
This corroborates that the consequences of memory corruption notably depend on the policy’s ability to tolerate or recover from altered decisions using the other input modes.

同样,尽管了解VLN的开放-开放敏感度较低,但与其他VLN相比,它遭受更大的封闭-开放成功率降解。

blocks.en: V-E Sensitivity to Textual Semantics
blocks.zh: V-E 对文字语义的敏感性

blocks.en:
We evaluate ISS on 100 open-loop samples where we corrupt only the navigation instructions by deleting groups of 1, 3, or 5 words, leaving the rest of the prompt unchanged.
For each sample, we manually annotated which semantic concepts in the language instruction are visually important for the next navigation decision.
Since human task-following typically relies on a set of semantic cues rather than a single isolated concept, our masks are full subtasks, e.g., “go down the stairs and turn right” rather than “stairs” or “right” only.

对于每个样本,我们手动注释语言指令中哪些语义概念对下一个导航决定很重要。
由于人类的任务跟踪通常依赖于一套语义提示而不是单一的孤立概念,因此我们的面具是完整的子任务,例如“下楼右转”,而不是“楼梯”或“右转”。

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 shows qualitative results of the ISS computed over the textual instruction.
Active subtask verbs and semantic cues show higher sensitivity, even when farther from the camera.
Table III reports precision results. CorrectNav consistently achieves the highest precision across all k k , indicating that the words producing the largest ISS changes are within the human-annotated decision-relevant concepts.
In contrast, AwareVLN has the most zero-ISS samples, meaning the baseline trajectory is robust to corruption and can infer the deleted segment from nearby context.
NaVILA combines the lowest precision with almost no zero-score cases, suggesting high dependence on the current active subtask text.
Many low-precision cases arise when the model is sensitive to semantically related cues outside the manually annotated span.
These often correspond to repeated concepts that remain strongly grounded in either visual memory or the current subtask.
Overall, sensitivity to text semantic cues is brittle and therefore not a strong indicator of input focus, since landmarks can repeat across the entire history.

blocks.en: V-F Sensitivity to Textual Memory
blocks.zh: V-F 对文字内存的敏感性

blocks.en:
We evaluate how textual memory context influences navigation decisions.
To ensure that each intervention produces a meaningful perturbation, we replace a percentage of the navigation instruction with antonyms rather than deleting them.
This reduces the chance of the model recovering the missing information from the surrounding context and introduces semantically conflicting cues to induce deviations from the unperturbed action.
Because antonym substitutions are introduced cumulatively from the beginning of the instruction and the experiments run over the ground-truth trajectory, low corruption affects early timesteps, while stronger corruption progressively reaches instruction content relevant to later decisions.
The boundary between low and high ISS should thus shift toward the right with trajectory completion.
blocks.zh:
我们评价文字记忆背景如何影响导航决定。
为了确保每次干预都产生有意义的扰动,我们将一定比例的导航指令用蚁名代替而不是删除。
这降低了模型从周围上下文中恢复缺失信息的机会,并引入了诱导偏离未扰动动作的强烈冲突提示.
由于自教学开始和实验在地面真相轨迹上累积引入了匿名替代,因此低腐败影响早期步骤,而更强烈的腐败逐渐达到与以后决定相关的教学内容。
因此,随着轨迹的完成,低空国际空间站和高空国际空间站之间的界限应转向右侧。

blocks.en: V-I Real World Deployment of Activation Steering

blocks.en:
We demonstrate the generalization of the identified steering vectors to the real world by evaluating over 40 trials across 8 scenes and 12 instructions using a sequential recovery protocol.
We consider the policy to have failed if it commits to the wrong choice and does not correct itself, or if it gets stuck in a loop.
The unmodified ( α = 0 \alpha=0 ) policy runs first.
When an operator identifies a failure based on the criterion above, we apply an activation intervention with α = 3 \alpha=3 in the target layer on the first token, forcing the policy to recover using reasoning.
We emphasize that we compute the mean vector for the action-to-reasoning data in simulation, which uses the pinhole camera.
This allows us to induce reasoning without changing parameters or collecting additional data in the new modality, directly in the real world.

blocks.en: VI Conclusions
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en:
This work presents the first causal interpretability study for VLM-based VLNs.
Our results suggest that while VLN policies are sensitive to many input and memory modalities, there is no apparent correlation between sensitivity and success rate.
Robustness appears to be primarily governed by a VLN policy’s ability to recover and adapt using other input modalities.
Surprisingly, our sensitivity studies to semantic concepts show that while there is some overlap with concepts relevant to humans, there is still similar sensitivity to concepts and areas deemed irrelevant.
This might be because the models are overfitting, the data is not sufficiently diverse, or the models rely on shortcuts.
We also show that semantic concepts from the original VLM survive and can be steered in the fine-tuned VLN, even if they are not part of its output action space.
Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot activation steering to induce model reasoning in real-world visual-distribution shift.
We show that this intervention, learned purely in simulation, can significantly improve success rate in out-of-domain scenarios without changing the network weights.
Future work could study whether a pattern emerges in the lack of focus on semantic cues, for instance, in navigable paths.
Another possible branch is using controllers for online tuning of α \alpha and operator-free activation steering.
blocks.zh:
这项工作为基于VLM的VLN提供了第一次因果可解释性研究.
我们的结果表明,虽然VLN政策对许多投入和记忆模式很敏感,但敏感性和成功率之间没有明显的关联。
实力似乎主要取决于VLN政策利用其他投入方式恢复和适应的能力。
令人惊讶的是,我们对语义概念的敏感度研究表明,虽然与人类相关的概念有一些重叠,但对被认为无关的概念和领域仍然有类似的敏感度.
这可能是因为模型过于适应,数据不够多样,或者模型依赖于快捷键.
我们还表明,原VLM的语义概念能够存活下来,并且可以在微调的VLN中被引导,即使它们不是其输出动作空间的一部分.
最后,我们演示了零镜头激活引导,在现实世界的视觉分布转变中诱导模型推理.
我们显示,这种纯粹在模拟中学习的干预,可以在不改变网络权重的情况下大幅度提高域外情景的成功率.
今后的工作可以研究在诸如可航行路径中缺乏对语义提示的重视是否出现一种模式。
另一个可能的分支是使用控制器在线调试α\α和操作员无操作器激活方向盘.
